analysis.description: This paper presents the construction and simulation of a full-scale, atlas-based reference model of the rat hippocampal CA1 region. It integrates a wide range of experimental data across multiple laboratories into a single, scalable in silico model capable of studying neuronal oscillations like the theta rhythm.

type.justification: The paper describes the development and testing of a computational model based on experimental data, which categorizes it as empirical research. The model was constructed using data from various labs and validated through simulations.
type.quote: To address this challenge, we present a community-based, full-scale in silico model of the rat CA1 that integrates a broad range of experimental data... We tested and validated each model component and the final network model...

name.justification: The research emphasizes the reconstruction and simulation of a model of the hippocampal CA1 region, which is central to understanding brain function, a core aspect of neuroscience.
name.quote: The hippocampus is thought to play a fundamental role in cognitive functions such as learning, memory, and spatial navigation [1,2]. It consists of three subfields of cornu ammonis (CA), CA1, CA2, and CA3...
